svg.title: Activity evidence to controller projection
svg.desc: The evidence-submission and preview-controller chain. Operations point to the inputs they consume and the evidence, events, or projections they produce. Compute Controller uses as input EvidenceSubmission. Typed predicate consumes; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.operation-21. Compute Controller creates or emits ControllerState. Typed predicate produces; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.operation-22. Compute Controller is constrained by Controller Selection Policy. Typed predicate governed_by; authority effect blocked; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.controller-governed-selection. ControllerState records Control Basis. Typed predicate records; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.controller-records-basis. ControllerState projects as a read model TerritoryUnit.
